import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../service/make_quiz.dart';

class QuizScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const QuizScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<QuizScreen> createState() => _QuizScreenState();
}

class _QuizScreenState extends State<QuizScreen> {
  late final Future<void> _loadQuizFuture;
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  bool _showJapanese = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadQuizFuture = loadQuiz();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: FutureBuilder<void>(
        future: _loadQuizFuture,
        builder: (context, snapshot) {
          if (snapshot.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          }

          final word = quizList.isNotEmpty ? quizList[_currentIndex] : null;
          return Center(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Text(
                  word?.english ?? '',
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineMedium,
                ),
                if (_showJapanese && word != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Text(
                    word.japanese,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: SafeArea(
        minimum: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: SizedBox(
          width: double.infinity,
          child: ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () {
              setState(() {
                if (!_showJapanese) {
                  _showJapanese = true;
                  return;
                }

                if (quizList.isEmpty) {
                  return;
                }

                _currentIndex = (_currentIndex + 1) % quizList.length;
                _showJapanese = false;
              });
            },
            child: Text(_showJapanese ? '次へ' : '答えを見る'),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'end.dart';
import '../service/make_quiz.dart';

class QuizScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const QuizScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<QuizScreen> createState() => _QuizScreenState();
}

class _QuizScreenState extends State<QuizScreen> {
  late final Future<void> _loadQuizFuture;
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  bool _showJapanese = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadQuizFuture = loadQuiz();
  }

  void _handleButtonPressed() {
    if (!_showJapanese) {
      setState(() {
        _showJapanese = true;
      });
      return;
    }

    if (quizList.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }

    if (_currentIndex == quizList.length - 1) {
      Navigator.of(context).pushReplacement(
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => const EndScreen()),
      );
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      _currentIndex++;
      _showJapanese = false;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: FutureBuilder<void>(
        future: _loadQuizFuture,
        builder: (context, snapshot) {
          if (snapshot.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          }

          final word = quizList.isNotEmpty ? quizList[_currentIndex] : null;
          return Center(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Text(
                  word?.english ?? '',
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineMedium,
                ),
                if (_showJapanese && word != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Text(
                    word.japanese,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: SafeArea(
        minimum: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: SizedBox(
          width: double.infinity,
          child: ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: _handleButtonPressed,
            child: Text(_showJapanese ? '次へ' : '答えを見る'),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
</attachment>

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'end.dart';
import '../service/make_quiz.dart';

class QuizScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const QuizScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<QuizScreen> createState() => _QuizScreenState();
}

class _QuizScreenState extends State<QuizScreen> {
  late final Future<void> _loadQuizFuture;
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  bool _showJapanese = false;

  String get _buttonLabel {
    if (_showJapanese &&
        quizList.isNotEmpty &&
        _currentIndex == quizList.length - 1) {
      return '終了';
    }

    return _showJapanese ? '次へ' : '答えを見る';
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadQuizFuture = loadQuiz();
  }

  void _handleButtonPressed() {
    if (!_showJapanese) {
      setState(() {
        _showJapanese = true;
      });
      return;
    }

    if (quizList.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }

    if (_currentIndex == quizList.length - 1) {
      Navigator.of(context).pushReplacement(
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => const EndScreen()),
      );
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      _currentIndex++;
      _showJapanese = false;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: FutureBuilder<void>(
        future: _loadQuizFuture,
        builder: (context, snapshot) {
          if (snapshot.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          }

          final word = quizList.isNotEmpty ? quizList[_currentIndex] : null;
          final progressText = '${quizList.isNotEmpty ? _currentIndex + 1 : 0}/${quizList.length}';
          return Stack(
            children: [
              SafeArea(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  child: Align(
                    alignment: Alignment.topLeft,
                    child: Text(progressText),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              Center(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      word?.english ?? '',
                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineMedium,
                    ),
                    if (_showJapanese && word != null) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      Text(
                        word.japanese,
                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: SafeArea(
        minimum: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: SizedBox(
          width: double.infinity,
          child: ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: _handleButtonPressed,
            child: Text(_buttonLabel),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
